why: Check 'selecting the same background color twice still applies the intended background styling to the second output' hits the repeat-lookup trigger; key change names the cache return.
Scroll-indicator checks never have an element selected, so the early-return on selection is not exercised.
Nothing about scrollbars or scroll indicators; only floored scroll and selection save.
Rotation handle is dragged but never at a zoom other than 100%.
Rotation handle targeting is checked only at default zoom; no zoom-dependent distance check.
Ctrl+G grouping is checked for outline, but never for the group's stacking relative to other elements.
Grouping and ungrouping are checked, but no z-order or layering check.
BORDERLINE: only delete-point then undo/redo is checked, not undo after dragging/finishing a point; key change says point edits are in undo/redo history.
BORDERLINE: history checks cover entering edit mode and same-element changes, not undo after finishing a point drag; key change names history for line editing.
BORDERLINE: only generic 'drag a multi-element selection' with spacing preserved, not pointer-down on an unselected grouped member; key change on selection top-left offset to pointer is close.
Only grid toggling, snapping and arrow nudge; no group dragging.
No check or change about the collab button being shown or hidden by the host handler.
Check 'collaboration button is shown when the host supplies the action, is absent when it does not' directly exposes the always-shown bug.
Offset embed is checked only for alignment after resize, and the load-into-view check lacks nonzero offsets; key change says loading recalculates scroll.
BORDERLINE: 'loading the prepared drawing brings its content into view' under the stated nonzero offsets; expected result is vague about centering.
Arrow-to-text binding is covered but no check edits bound text and then confirms the arrow stays attached.
Only an empty text edit is checked, not editing text of a bound element and checking the arrow stays bound.
Grouping the shape with its text is checked, but not text bound to a container already inside a group.
No group-related check for bound text.
Popup open/close checks never place the canvas away from the page origin, so the offset shift is not exercised.
Link editing is checked but never with a nonzero editor offset or popup position.
BORDERLINE: 'selecting only items that are bound text or containers with text offers vertical alignment' covers the mixed-selection case that the bug hid.
Control is checked only for a single shape with attached text; key change names 'every selected element' condition.
BORDERLINE: key change and uncertainty mention native file-handle capture, but no check opens via picker and then saves back.
Import checks only; no file handle or Save-back check.
Nothing about clicking inside a selected line's bounding box to deselect.
Check clicking inside the selected line's bounding rectangle away from the stroke, expecting it not to be a hit and the underlying element targetable, exposes the failure to deselect.
Handle rendering is checked for collab alignment, but never with other elements overlapping the edited line.
Handle visibility is checked for collab only; no overlapping-element or covered-point drag check.
BORDERLINE: check that a custom footer button supplied inside Footer appears would show the missing footer on a minified build, but never mentions production/minified builds.
BORDERLINE: checks that centered footer child content with a marker appears would fail on a minified build, but no production-build condition is stated.

BORDERLINE: check drag-duplicates a selection containing a deleted-but-selected object and expects deleted content stays absent; does not say the deleted element must remain in the scene for undo/sync.
BORDERLINE: uncertainty/key change notes the drag path looked up selection including deleted objects; checks are generic dragging and do not Alt-drag duplicate.
Checks press plain H and Space+hand tool; none presses Alt+Shift+H or tests modifier handling.
Checks only plain H and toolbar; no modifier combination with H or distribute horizontally.
BORDERLINE: key change notes the embeddable API toggles a sidebar by name and optional tab; checks request Library twice/force open-close but never switch tabs of an open sidebar via the API.
Checks open named sidebar and select tabs via UI/capability but not API toggle to a different tab while open.
Store/history area covered but nothing about older browsers or Object.hasOwn.
Store observed-state change mentioned but no check on browsers lacking Object.hasOwn and no cause named.
BORDERLINE: check searches lowercase 'align' expecting alignment commands, which would fail on the case-sensitive build; case is not called out.
BORDERLINE: lowercase searches like 'dark', 'team', 'stop' expected to find commands could expose case-sensitivity; key change names fuzzy, accent-insensitive search normalization but not case.
Undo/redo disabled-state checked on empty history only; no view mode exit check.
Undo/redo enabled state checked before/after edits, never after toggling view mode.
Check Alt-clicking a segment midpoint of an elbow arrow expects no point added, which would reveal the duplicated point; key change says elbow arrows no longer accept segment midpoints.
BORDERLINE: two successive laser strokes check and key change that updating a trail discards completed laser trails; expected result is vague about fading on pointerup.
Only lasso selection; laser pointer trail not mentioned.
Touch/desktop selection behaviour only; nothing about startup with undefined navigator.platform/userAgent.
BORDERLINE: key change notes platform detection and a new mobile classification, but no check or note about undefined navigator values or a load crash.
Deleting an assistant reply is checked only for truncation; preview refresh after removal is not checked.
Only prompt limits, streaming and preview insertion; no message removal or preview refresh.
BORDERLINE: check adds more Ctrl+arrow nodes in same direction but expects earlier nodes keep positions, not that the group stays centered on parent.
BORDERLINE: check extends a pending group from one node to two but only asserts first node stays put, not centering on the parent.
BORDERLINE: key change says a single frame-associated element is inserted at end of order rather than frame position; no check deletes a child above the frame before adding new children.
Frame ordering checks cover paste and drag; none deletes a frame child above the frame then adds a new child.
BORDERLINE: check score=0 filter exercises the falsy-value skip; uses numeric 0 not boolean false, same mechanism.
BORDERLINE: check filters numeric field with 0 and key change says falsy values are skipped; same mechanism as false but not a boolean false query.
